1.2.0.changelog:
✨ Features:
 ᛫ ⚙️ Settings: Added Compact listing mode for Updates view
 ᛫ 🕜 Custom time filtering is now available
 ᛫ 📖 Ticket details view is now available with default fields! (custom fields tbd)
 ᛫ 🌐 Added link to GitHub in settings
 ᛫ 😣 Added logs and diagnostics options to help troubleshooting

🧼 Chores
 ᛫ Bumped version number.
 ᛫ Removed dependency to flutter_json.
 ᛫ Added dependency to fading_edge_scrollview and calendar_date_picker2.
 ᛫ Refactored the ticket details 🡢 json view for more helpful debugging and inspection

🐛 Known bugs
 ᛫ Emojis are not rendered in comments (there is no Atlassian API for that)
 ᛫ Newer request is dropped by UI if project filters are changed before request completes
 ᛫ Comments: nested replies are not shown as nested
